nativeSource:
asString
  "Convert to a String with Characters for each byte"

  | str |
  str := String new: self size.
  1 to: self size do: [:i |str at: i put: (Character value: (self at: i))].
  ^str
gtSource: asString	<gtGsExtension>	"Convert to a String with Characters for each byte.	Fast code uses primitive that avoids character conversion"	^ (String new: self size) replaceFrom: 1 to: self size with: self

nativeSource:
hex
	"Answer a hexa decimal representation of the receiver"
	| string v index map |
	map := '0123456789abcdef'.
	string := String new: self size * 2. "hex"
	index := 0.
	1 to: self size do: [ :i |
		v := self at: i.
		string at: (index := index + 1) put: (map at: (v bitShift: -4) + 1).
		string at: (index := index + 1) put: (map at: (v bitAnd: 15) + 1)].
	^string
gtSource: hex <gtGsExtension>	"Answer a lowercase hexadecimal String representation of the receiver"	^ String		new: self size * 2		streamContents: [ :out |			self do: [ :each | each printLowercaseHexByteOn: out ] ]

nativeSource:
newFromPairs: anArray 
	"Answer an instance of me associating (anArray at:i) to (anArray at: i+i)
	 for each odd i.  anArray must have an even number of entries.
	  Dictionary newFromPairs: {'Red' . Color red . 'Blue' . Color blue . 'Green' . Color green}. "
	| newDictionary |

	newDictionary := self new: (anArray size/2).
	1 to: (anArray size-1) by: 2 do: [ :i|
		newDictionary at: (anArray at: i) put: (anArray at: i+1).
	].
	^ newDictionary
gtSource: newFromPairs: anArray <gtGsExtension>	"Answer an instance of me associating (anArray at: i) to (anArray at: i+1)	 for each odd i.  anArray must have an even number of entries."	"Dictionary newFromPairs: {'Red' . Color red . 'Blue' . Color blue . 'Green' . Color green}."	| newDictionary |	newDictionary := self new: anArray size / 2.	1 to: anArray size - 1 by: 2 do: [ :i | newDictionary at: (anArray at: i) put: (anArray at: i + 1) ].	^ newDictionary

nativeSource:
readFrom: aStringOrStream ifFail: aBlock
  "Answer an instance of one of the concrete subclasses if Integer. 
	Initial minus sign accepted.
	Imbedded radix specifiers not allowed;  use Number 
	class readFrom: for that.
	Execute aBlock if there are no digits."

  ^ (NumberParser on: aStringOrStream) nextIntegerBase: 10 ifFail: aBlock
gtSource: readFrom: aStringOrStream ifFail: aBlock	<gtGsExtension>	"Read an optional minus sign and decimal digits, answering the failure block when no digits exist."	| stream sign value hasDigits |	stream := aStringOrStream isString		ifTrue: [ aStringOrStream readStream ]		ifFalse: [ aStringOrStream ].	sign := 1.	(stream atEnd not and: [ stream peek = $- ])		ifTrue: [ sign := -1. stream next ].	value := 0.	hasDigits := false.	[ stream atEnd not and: [ '0123456789' includes: stream peek ] ]		whileTrue: [			hasDigits := true.			value := value * 10 + stream next digitValue ].	^ hasDigits ifTrue: [ value * sign ] ifFalse: [ aBlock value ]

nativeSource:
closeTo: num
	"are these two numbers close?"

	num isFloat ifTrue: [^ num closeTo: self asFloat].
	^[self = num] ifError: [false]
gtSource: closeTo: num <gtGsExtension> (num isKindOf: Float) ifTrue: [ ^ num closeTo: self asFloat ]. ^ [ self = num ] on: Error do: [ :error | false ]

nativeSource:
assert: aBlock
	"Throw an assertion error if aBlock does not evaluates to true."

	aBlock value ifFalse: [AssertionFailure signal: 'Assertion failed']
gtSource: assert: aBlock	<gtGsExtension>	"Throw an assertion error if aBlock does not evaluates to true.	We check for true explicitly to make the assertion fail for non booleans"	self assert: aBlock description: 'Assertion failed'

nativeSource:
addedToZnUrl: url
	| segments |
	segments := self findTokens: '/'.
	^ url withPathSegments: segments

gtSource:
asZnUrl
	<gtGsExtension>
	| zinc |
	zinc := Globals at: #ZincGlobals ifAbsent: [ nil ].
	^ (zinc
		ifNil: [ ZnUrl ]
		ifNotNil: [ zinc at: #ZnUrl ]) fromString: self
